integrity: The conclusion is derived from exact block formulas and strict convexity. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof, and no claim of independent validation or priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The construction gives one explicit reflexive strictly convex example and does not classify which stronger geometric hypotheses force an attained saturation witness. Older literature may contain equivalent James-constant nonattainment examples under different terminology; the checked novelty is the exact conjunction with the 2026 Birkhoff saturation parameter and its full approximate profile.
title: Zero Birkhoff saturation without an extremal pair in a reflexive strictly convex space
